items.title: Medifast Announces Cooperation Agreement with Steamboat Capital
items.summary: Company Agrees to Nominate Parsa Kiai and Jeff Rose as Director Candidates at 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders Medifast, Inc. (NYSE: MED), the metabolic health and wellness company known for its science-backed, coach-guided lifestyle system, today announced the company's Board of Directors has agreed to nominate Parsa Kiai and Jeff Rose from Steamboat Capital Partners LLC as independent director candidates to stand for election at the company’s 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders, which is provisionally scheduled for May 19, 2026. These nominations are pursuant to a Cooperation Agreement entered into between the company and Steamboat Capital, which beneficially owns above 5% of the company’s outstanding shares. The Board of Directors has determined that Medifast’s directors Jeffrey Brown and Michael Hoer will not stand for reelection. items.title: Championing Water Access: World Water Day
items.summary: Water, life’s most essential resource, touches every aspect of our lives. We recognize that water is an essential resource, vital for health, food production, and so much more – but in many parts of the world, clean water access is not as easy as just turning on a tap. This World Water Day and every day, we recognize the critical need for clean water, while acknowledging that global water challenges affect everyone, but not equally, especially impacting women and girls.
